of India |issn=0971-8257}} == Features == While connecting Vastral Gam to Thaltej Gam, this line will be passing through Nirant Cross Road, Vastral, Rabari Colony, Amraiwadi, Apparel Park, Kankaria East, Kalupur Railway Station, Ghee Kanta, Shahpur, Old High Court, Stadium, Commerce Six Road, Gujarat University, Gurukul Road, Doordarshan Kendra, Thaltej and Thaltej Gam stations. The total distance of the corridor is {{convert|21.23|km|mi|abbr=on}} with most of the it being elevated. The underground section is approximately {{Cvt|6.5|km}} in length with 4 underground stations, while the elevated section has 14 elevated stations. Old High Court station serves as an interchange station for the Blue Line and [[Red Line (Ahmedabad Metro)|Red Line]]. The underground section is constructed about 22 metre deep at the lowest level near Gheekanta station. The other three underground stations are about 12-14 metres deep.{{Cite web |date=2022-07-11 |title=Chugging in, clearing hurdles: Prime Minister to inaugurate Phase I of Ahmedabad Metro in August this year |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/ahmedabad/prime-minister-to-inaugurate-phase-i-of-ahmedabad-metro-in-august-this-year-8021341/ |access-date=2022-07-13 |website=The Indian Express |language=en}} == List of stations == Following is a list of stations on this route: {|class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;" width="80%" |- | style="text-align:center; background:#{{rcr|Ahmedabad Metro|blue}};" colspan="8" | '''Blue Line''' |- ! rowspan="2"|# ! colspan="2"|Station Name ! rowspan="2"|Opening ! rowspan="2"|Connections ! rowspan="2"|Layout |- !
